explanation: Append a coordinate 1 to each vector: v_j = (1, z_j) in K^(d+1). N > d + 1 = dim vectors are linearly dependent (LinearIndependent.fintype_card_le_finrank), so some nonzero alpha has sum alpha_j v_j = 0; the extra coordinate gives sum alpha_j = 0 and the others give sum alpha_j z_j = 0.
